notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Goldberry.
Goldberry does not have summoning sickness.
Goldberry and Geralf's Mindcrusher do not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher, adding {U}.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability and Goldberry trigger.
Resolve the Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Holding priority, activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Goldberry.
Activate Goldberry's first ability by tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Geralf's Mindcrusher onto Goldberry.
Resolve the Goldberry trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Activate Goldberry's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Goldberry onto any permanent except Geralf's Mindcrusher, and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
